radiusSource: Radius 1.203 +/- 0.074 solar radii from Bakos et al. 2010, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-23 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010arXiv1008.3388B/abstract): 836,927 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.13 +/- 0.035 solar masses from Bakos et al. 2010, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-23 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010arXiv1008.3388B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM.
